[[File:Cantinaackmena.jpg|thumb|The flower which Krelman presented to Ackmena]]
The humanoid [[Krelman]] attempted to woo the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] by presenting her with a [[Flower/Legends|flower]] during one of her shifts, as he had become smitten with her. He placed the flower on top of his glass. She exclaimed that people rarely bring her flowers, but she rejected his advances. Later, after the Empire forced the bar to close down and she ushered the patrons out for the final time, Ackmena found Krelman waiting for her behind the bar, and he gladly presented her with the flower again. She seemed less reluctant, while the Imperial transmission came to a close.<ref name="HS">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The flower first appeared in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''.<ref name="HS" />
